criteria.statement: The prefilter precondition is confirmed in the evidence log, or the slice is stopped and recorded
matcher.ts filters variants by a per-catalog WeakMap of card-ingredient counts before getVariant when there is no explicit combo intent; catalog.ts is unchanged
The equivalence test covers the 50 most-comboed cards, a seeded pair sample, both wordings and both modes, and passes in about 10 s or less
The integrity test decodes every committed variant and passes
Backend suite is green and eval goldens are byte-identical to origin/main
Before/after timings for Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar and Sensei's Divining Top are recorded
